title: Sprint Start Reaction and First-10m Split
dataSources: Bar-velocity reps (`vbt:rep`), sprint reps (`sprint:rep`), serve attempts (`serve:attempt`), pickleball rallies (`pickleball:rally`), swim sets (`swim:set`), archery ends (`archery:end`), balance trials (`balance:trial`), and batting reps (`batting:rep`).
app: Sports and skill telemetry from VBT devices, sprint timers, serve trackers, swim logs, archery apps, balance trainers, and batting sensors streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=sprint:rep
| stats avg(reaction_ms) as avg_reaction_ms avg(split_10m_s) as avg_split_10m_s by athlete session
| sort athlete session
description: Summarises start reaction time and first-10-metre speed for each sprint session.
value: The first ten metres often tell the story of acceleration quality better than a full sprint time alone.
implementation: Capture each sprint rep from a timing gate or phone app with reaction and split metrics included.
visualization: Scatter plot of reaction time versus first-10m split by session.
grandmaExplanation: It counts how quickly each sprint starts and how fast the first short burst is going.
